description: Defines the HpackEntryDecoder class responsible for decoding a single HPACK header entry in HTTP/2, including its states, methods for starting and resuming decoding, and related utilities.

classes.name: HpackEntryDecoder
classes.description: Decodes a single HPACK header entry, managing its internal state and decoding process.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins decoding a header entry from the provided decode buffer.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Continues decoding if previous decoding was in progress.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string for debugging purposes.

methods.name: OutputDebugString
methods.description: Outputs debug information to a stream.
